page.layout: One page of text in one column, running head at the top, signature and page number at the foot. No margin notes.

p.i: phiæ imputentur; multo minus, vt propterea innocens illa Diua in odium & invidiam studiosæ iuuentutis vocetur, aut omnino in exilium pellatur: quin potius in id incumbendum omnibus esse existimaui, vt illa depurata, extricata & illustrata germanæ & natiuæ suæ formæ restituatur, & ad verum ac legitimum vsum reducatur: id quod etiam hactenus à me pro virili factum est, & in posterum, Deo volente & iuuante, sedulo ac fideliter fiet.

main_text.p: Quoniam vero inter omnes artes & disciplinas Philosophicas ceu domina & regina eminet METAPHYSICA; eiusque cultura animos studiosorum ad certarum doctrinarum satus melius & facilius accipiendos disponit & præparat; non paruum operæ pretium me facturum putaui, si illius præcepta, quæ ab Aristotele & plerisque eius interpretibus prolixe, perplexe, confuse & imperfecte traduntur, systemate

page.notes: The first word "phiæ" is a fragment from the previous line and is kept as printed. The top-right corner mark "D" is a corner mark or signature-like stroke, not running text, so it is left out. The bottom-right faint watermark is a digitiser's mark and is left out. The large Q of "Quoniam" is a decorative initial and is printed as Q. The word METAPHYSICA is printed in small capitals, with a decorative glyph for the H/Φ part, which is transcribed as HYSICA after the M-E-T-A letters.
